sents.t: A toast to our new candidate, Elio Solís of UhEarth.
sents.zh: 敬我们的新候选人，地球的埃利奥·索利斯。

sents.t: Candidate Solís, you continue to surprise.
sents.zh: 候选人索利斯，你总能带来惊喜。

sents.t: Because there's 500 million habitable planets out there and one of them's got to want me!
sents.zh: 因为外面有五亿颗宜居行星，总有一颗会想要我！

sents.t: We can send spacecraft to nearby planets.
sents.zh: 我们可以把探测器送到邻近的行星。

sents.t: Are we alone?
sents.zh: 我们是孤独的吗？

sents.t: I just feel so alone.
sents.zh: 我只是觉得好孤独。

sents.t: You put flyers up for a Ham Radio Club?
sents.zh: 你贴了业余无线电社的传单？

sents.t: We can use large radio telescopes to see if there is any message being sent to us lately.
sents.zh: 我们可以用大型射电望远镜，看看最近有没有人在给我们发消息。

sents.t: Aliens are not coming for you.
sents.zh: 外星人不会来接你的。

sents.t: I knew aliens were looking for me.
sents.zh: 我就知道外星人在找我。

sents.t: We track space debris, not rogue UFO signals.
sents.zh: 我们跟踪的是太空碎片，不是那些乱来的不明飞行物信号。

sents.t: We're in a debris field.
sents.zh: 我们在碎片带里。

sents.t: I've never been a bargaining chip before.
sents.zh: 我还从来没当过谈判筹码。

sents.t: I'll take care of the bargaining chip.
sents.zh: 筹码交给我来处理。

sents.t: Are you an expert on conflict negotiation?
sents.zh: 你是冲突谈判方面的专家吗？

sents.t: While you negotiate with the warlord, you'll need a temporary replacement.
sents.zh: 你去和那个军阀谈判的时候，需要一个临时替身。

sents.t: Would a clone really fool my dad?
sents.zh: 一个克隆体真能骗过我爸爸吗？

sents.t: Can I check on my clone?
sents.zh: 我能看看我的克隆体吗？

sents.t: Or should I say, Ambassador Solís.
sents.zh: 或者我该叫你，索利斯大使。

sents.t: Congratulations, Ambassador Solís!
sents.zh: 恭喜你，索利斯大使！

cards.ex: A candidate is a person who wants to be chosen for a job or a role.
exs: She is a candidate for class president.
cards.note: 原句：“A toast to our new candidate, Elio Solís of UhEarth.”（敬我们的新候选人，地球的埃利奥·索利斯。）

cards.ex: A planet is a large world that moves around a star, like Earth around the Sun.
exs: Mars is the planet next to us.
cards.note: 原句：“We can send spacecraft to nearby planets.”（我们可以把探测器送到邻近的行星。）

cards.ex: Alone means by yourself, with no one else. It can also mean you feel lonely.
exs: She sat alone by the window.
cards.note: 原句：“Are we alone?”（我们是孤独的吗？）

cards.ex: Radio is a way to send sound through the air, or the device you use to listen to it. A ham radio is a radio that people use to talk to others far away.
exs: He talked to a friend in another city on the radio.
cards.note: 原句：“We can use large radio telescopes to see if there is any message being sent to us lately.”（我们可以用大型射电望远镜，看看最近有没有人在给我们发消息。）

cards.ex: An alien is a living being from another planet, not from Earth.
exs: The movie is about a boy who wants to meet aliens.
cards.note: 原句：“Aliens are not coming for you.”（外星人不会来接你的。）

cards.ex: Debris is the broken pieces left after something is destroyed, or trash floating in space.
cards.note: 原句：“We're in a debris field.”（我们在碎片带里。）

cards.ex: A bargaining chip is something you can use in a deal, so the other side will give you what you want.
exs: The extra ticket became a bargaining chip in the trade.
cards.note: 原句：“I've never been a bargaining chip before.”（我还从来没当过谈判筹码。）

cards.ex: Negotiate means to talk with someone and try to reach an agreement. Negotiation is that talk.
exs: We need to negotiate a fair price.
cards.note: 原句：“While you negotiate with the warlord, you'll need a temporary replacement.”（你去和那个军阀谈判的时候，需要一个临时替身。）

cards.ex: A clone is a copy of a living thing that is made to look and act just like the original.
exs: The clone looked exactly like him.
cards.note: 原句：“Would a clone really fool my dad?”（一个克隆体真能骗过我爸爸吗？）

cards.ex: An ambassador is a person chosen to speak and act for a country, or for a group, in another place.
exs: She was named ambassador to France.
cards.note: 原句：“Or should I say, Ambassador Solís.”（或者我该叫你，索利斯大使。）
